    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    a = list(map(int, input[1:n+1]))
    b = list(map(int, input[n+1:2*n+1]))

    def calculate_sum(a, b):
        return sum(abs(x - y) for x, y in zip(a, b))

    original_sum = calculate_sum(a, b)
    min_sum = original_sum

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            b[i], b[j] = b[j], b[i]
            new_sum = calculate_sum(a, b)
            if new_sum < min_sum:
                min_sum = new_sum
            b[i], b[j] = b[j], b[i]

    print(min_sum)
